title: Corridor Now (v1.0.0)
description: Live fleet state for corridor C6-008, direction 1. Produced by the data layer (gold view). Screen US-04. See ADR-0003.

schema_version.description: Read contract version (SemVer). Turn 1 produces only 1.0.0.

snapshot_id.description: UUID v4 identifying this gold snapshot. Same value as source_status.snapshot_id for the same computation cycle.

as_of_ts.description: UTC timestamp when the gold view was computed.

direction.description: Travel direction. Turn 1 supports direction 1 only (station to neighbourhood).

buses.description: One entry per active bus currently on the corridor, ordered by distance_along_m descending (leader first — the bus furthest along the route).

prev_stop_id.description: Stop id the bus most recently departed. Uses real P-<objectid> ids from data/reference/stops.csv.

next_stop_id.description: Stop id the bus is heading towards.

distance_along_m.description: Distance from origin (P-883, 0 m) to terminus (P-900, 5119.4 m) in meters. No geometry in turn 1.

headway_ahead_s.description: Gap in seconds to the bus immediately ahead (higher distance_along_m, further along the route). Null for the leader bus (no bus ahead on the corridor) or for a broken_down bus. A broken_down bus is excluded from headway calculations: the bus behind it measures its gap to the next operational bus ahead, skipping the broken_down bus.

headway_planned_s.description: Planned headway in seconds for this time window. Turn 1 peak value: 600 s.

bus_state.description: Computed state. 'leader': furthest-ahead bus on the corridor (headway_ahead_s is null — no bus ahead). 'regular': within tolerance. 'bunched': headway_ahead_s < 0.5 * headway_planned_s. 'gap': headway_ahead_s > 1.5 * headway_planned_s. 'broken_down': incident of type bus_breakdown active for this bus.

data_quality.description: Per-bus data quality. 'live': last event within 2 min. 'estimated': no report > 2 min; position is extrapolated; no alert raised.

ts.description: UTC timestamp of the event_ts from the last bus_position event used for this entry.

buses_in_service.description: Number of active buses on the corridor (not broken down, not in reserve).
